name: cobblestone
description: Local-first, collaborative knowledge base — a full Obsidian replacement.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/node/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/app/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w @cobblestone/desktop && node scripts/e2e-desktop.mjs && node scripts/e2e-web.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run recette && npm run journal
